criteria.reason: The donor-relief story has a coherent, restrained visual system and clear action hierarchy. Results foreground the sponsor amount, donor outcome and ongoing gift together; the phone unresolved state communicates uncertainty clearly without burying the money state.

Rich transcripts and check/record sections also create a long evidence-heavy result. These are observed presentation-density costs, not a claim of failed human usability.

criteria.reason: After-hours donor care and sponsor-backed hardship relief form a specific useful mechanism: an eligible donor can recover this month’s gift while the recurring relationship remains active, with an auditable decision trail. The executable mechanism and task completion evidence make the impact case more concrete than a concept pitch.
strengths: Actual sandbox relief plus the six disposable scenarios establish the intended behavior and failure boundaries.
The paired pipeline completes paraphrase/negation tasks that the keyword baseline misses, supporting a plausible access benefit within those cases.
The packet provides nonprofit monthly-giving and donor-retention context with population and period limits; no claim of measured app uplift is needed to understand the problem.
criteria.deduction: Magnitude and adoption remain uncertain: the evidence contains no observed donor/staff benefit, sponsor commitment or demonstrated sponsor economics, and equal gross capture/refund still incurs fees. Existing services already handle conventional recurring-gift management. These bound the strength of the impact claim; they are not mandatory production or human-study gates.

criteria.reason: The strongest distinction is the combination of conversational supported-task completion, sponsor-first hardship relief, exact renewed consent, sentence evidence and a tamper-evident receipt. The new paired outcome result supplies concrete evidence that the composed routing contributes useful behavior on these tasks.
strengths: The product connects relief execution and preservation of an active recurring gift rather than merely explaining a refund.
Unknown outcomes, exact approval and read-backed claims are visible parts of the experience.
Composed6/6 versus rules1/6 on the contextual task group is a meaningful bounded outcome difference.
criteria.deduction: The novelty is an integration and workflow combination, not a new payment primitive or an established first-of-kind market claim. The current comparison includes deterministic guards and does not isolate a pure LLM gain; AI purchasing has not demonstrated price savings, and three controlled supplier endpoints share one sandbox merchant.

threeMaterialDeductions.improvement: Keep these separate result contracts and limitations adjacent to every task-completion claim; do not describe the new test as twelve wholly unseen cases or general AI superiority.

threeMaterialDeductions.finding: A useful working relief mechanism has not yet established the scale of benefit or sponsor participation economics.
